Things I build for fun, mostly to solve my own problems.

## 29 and Call Bridge

The two card games of my college years, rebuilt to play against computer opponents on my phone, with the house rules we actually used. Friends can also join a private online table by invitation.

## Daba

A chess app that teaches as you play. It highlights the legal moves, suggests a move when asked, and offers basic and advanced computer opponents.

## Bangla Tamil Talk

A Bengali–Tamil voice translator for Android, built after my family moved to Chennai, for everyday conversations at shops and at home.

## My CV as a network

An interactive graph of my career, where each hub opens into its own subgraph. [Explore it](cv-network.html) or [read the post](posts/2026-11-cv-network/index.qmd).

---

The apps are not on any app store. If you would like an APK to try, please feel free to reach out to me.
